findings.issue: loadAbilityPage re-implements the pokemon-ref→card loop (id≤10000 filter, speciesById lookup, dedup) inline to add the hidden flag, instead of extending cardsFromPokemonRefs
findings.suggestion: Extend cardsFromPokemonRefs with an optional per-ref decorator (or have it accept raw entries carrying is_hidden) so card membership rules live in one function

findings.issue: Type badge markup `type-badge type-${name}` is inlined in five places across four files (PokemonCard.tsx:6, pokemon.$name.tsx:76, moves.$name.tsx:31, types.$name.tsx:36)
findings.suggestion: Promote TypePill into a shared TypeBadge that renders either a span or a Link, and use it everywhere

findings.issue: power/accuracy/pp null→Number coercion duplicated verbatim between loadMovePage and loadPokemonPage (also at :386-390)
findings.suggestion: Extract a small nullableNumber(value) helper in format.ts

findings.issue: Home search shape (q/type/generation/page) is known in three places: validateSearch (index.tsx:13), the server-fn validator (data.functions.ts:14), and defensive typeof re-checks here
findings.suggestion: Move the param parsing into the server fn's validator so loadHome receives already-normalized values

findings.issue: loadTypePage rebuilds typeMap inline when getTypeMap() (line 139) already exists
rowsByMethod typed Map<string, any[]> and rows carry a `method` field absent from the MoveRow interface (model.ts:39-48) — type drift around the moves tables
findings.suggestion: Type the map as Map<string, MoveRow[]> and drop the stray method field from the row objects

findings.issue: #moves anchor scroll implemented as a manual window.location.hash effect (rAF + scrollIntoView), a special case embedded in the route while the router already sets scrollRestoration (router.tsx:11)
findings.suggestion: Use TanStack Router's hash/scroll handling (or a small shared hook) so the route component doesn't own scroll wiring

findings.issue: Two parallel builders of the home query object: updateSearch (line 48, always resets page) and pageSearch (line 66, preserves filters)
findings.suggestion: Extract one query-builder that takes the next filter/page deltas so the URL contract is defined once

findings.issue: head title 'Pokédex' duplicates the root route default (app/src/routes/__root.tsx:13) — harmless but a redundant override to trip over
findings.suggestion: Drop the override and let the root title stand

summary: This is an idiomatic current-stable TanStack Start app — the .server.ts/.functions.ts/model.ts layering, validator()-based server fns and shellComponent root document are all the shape a maintainer would want, and data-source, caching and card-construction changes each land in one file. The editability cost is concentrated in a few copy-paste seams: the ability card loop, inlined type-badge markup, duplicated nullable-number coercion and a triple-known search schema. Those are cheap to fix now and would be easy to navigate later, so the codebase is comfortably above average to change.
